tracks.title: Neuropharmacology & Neurotherapeutics
tracks.description: Neurodegeneration, neuroinflammation, synaptic dysfunction, epilepsy, and neuropsychiatric disorders; mechanistic target validation and experimental pharmacotherapeutics for CNS disease.

tracks.title: Cerebrovascular & Neuro-Metabolic Pharmacology
tracks.description: Stroke, ischemia-reperfusion injury, neurovascular dysfunction, brain insulin resistance, obesity, and diabetes-associated cognitive impairment; the links between metabolic dysfunction and neurological disease.

tracks.title: Cancer Pharmacology & Neuro-Oncology
tracks.description: Glioma, brain metastases, cancer metabolism, tumor-microenvironment interactions, anticancer target validation, and treatment resistance; mechanisms linking cancer biology with CNS complications.

tracks.title: Biotechnology & Translational Disease Models
tracks.description: Biologics, RNA-based approaches, extracellular vesicles, disease biomarkers, and multi-omics; cellular, iPSC-derived, and organoid models for studying neuro-metabolic disorders and evaluating therapeutic candidates.

tracks.title: Medicinal Chemistry & Target Validation
tracks.description: Pharmacophore design, structure-activity relationships, lead optimization, target engagement, and selectivity; discovery and characterization of chemical entities for neuro-metabolic disorders and cancer.

tracks.title: Synthetic Chemistry & Chemical Biology
tracks.description: Novel synthetic methods, catalysis, green chemistry, bioactive natural-product synthesis, and chemical probes; enabling chemistry to investigate disease mechanisms and support drug discovery.

tracks.title: In-silico & AI-Driven Drug Design
tracks.description: Molecular docking, molecular dynamics, QSAR, chemoinformatics, generative AI, and multi-omics integration; interpretable models and experimental validation of predictions for CNS, metabolic, and cancer targets.

tracks.title: Pharmacovigilance-Guided Drug Repurposing & Network Pharmacology
tracks.description: Safety-signal analysis, real-world data, drug-target-disease networks, systems pharmacology, and pathway analysis to generate repurposing hypotheses for neuro-metabolic disorders and cancer. Signals require validation and do not establish causality or treatment efficacy.

tracks.title: Indian Indigenous Systems & Ethnopharmacology
tracks.description: Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, and ethnobotanical knowledge; phytochemical characterization, formulation standardization, herb-drug interactions, safety, and mechanistic evaluation in neuro-metabolic disease models.

tracks.title: Toxicology & Safety Pharmacology
tracks.description: Neurotoxicity, metabolic and organ toxicity, environmental exposures, genotoxicity, and preclinical safety assessment; mechanism-based biomarkers and alternative experimental models for evaluating therapeutic risks.
